t,x,v,a=df['t'].values,df['x'].values,df['v'].values,df['dv_dt'].values
def run(w, K=7):
    c=np.cos(w*t);s=np.sin(w*t)
    L={'x':x,'v':v,'x3':x**3,'v3':v**3,'v2':v*v,'x2':x*x,'logv':np.log(v),'logx':np.log(x),'sqrtv':np.sqrt(v),'1/v':1/v,'1/x':1/x,
       'expv':np.exp(-v),'expx':np.exp(-x),'exp-x2':np.exp(-x*x),'exp-v2':np.exp(-v*v),'sqrtx':np.sqrt(x),'c':c,'s':s,'cx':c*x,'sx':s*x,'cv':c*v,'sv':s*v,
       'v*logx':v*np.log(x),'x*logv':x*np.log(v),'xv':x*v,'x2v':x*x*v,'xv2':x*v*v,'tanhv':np.tanh(v),'sinv':np.sin(v),'sinx':np.sin(x),'cosv':np.cos(v),'cosx':np.cos(x),
       'vexpx':v*np.exp(-x),'x*exp-v':x*np.exp(-v),'v/x':v/x,'x/v':x/v,'cos2':np.cos(2*w*t),'sin2':np.sin(2*w*t),'t':t,'tx':t*x,'tv':t*v}
    names=list(L.keys()); M=np.column_stack([np.ones_like(t)]+[L[k] for k in names])
    cur=[0]; hist=[]
    for step in range(K):
        best=None
        for j in range(1,M.shape[1]):
            if j in cur: continue
            idx=cur+[j]
            cc=np.linalg.lstsq(M[:,idx],a,rcond=None)[0]
            n=np.var(a-M[:,idx]@cc)/np.var(a)
            if best is None or n<best[0]: best=(n,j)
        cur.append(best[1]); hist.append((round(best[0],6),names[best[1]-1]))
    cc=np.linalg.lstsq(M[:,cur],a,rcond=None)[0]
    return hist, np.round(cc,3)
